name: Community Home
description: A simple home page for a community. Editors set the title and tagline and add sections (plain text or HTML), links and links to public frames, in any order, and preview what visitors see; everyone else — viewers, and anyone the frame is published to — sees the page, updated live. Links open in the visitor's own browser tab. The page is the space's own table (community_home_blocks) plus a few settings rows.
